notes.writer: Provisional category. 3 figure briefs. n-dimensional test proved from Taylor; determinant form stated. Links to Taylor and Lagrange siblings are unpublished batch dependencies.
notes.illustrator: 3 original SVGs. Rendered in Chrome at 680 px and 240 px and visually inspected. Level c=-2,-3 omitted from the contour brief because the global minimum is -1.
notes.reviewer: Mathematical, editorial and SVG structural gates PASS; mandatory visual-inspection gate NOT_RUN (no image-capable model in this environment). Review evidence: batches/20261126T222013Z-01/evidence/multivariable-extrema-and-saddle-points/review.md.
